title: Colorful Mediterranean Alley
description: A narrow sunlit alleyway with vibrant yellow and orange buildings lines a steep stone staircase under a clear blue sky. The cobblestone path and steps are adorned with numerous potted plants and flowers in terracotta pots.
prompt: A narrow European alley with bright yellow and orange stucco buildings on both sides, featuring a steep stone staircase leading up between them under a clear blue sky. The colorful cobblestone path at the bottom is lined with many terracotta pots containing green plants and vibrant pink, purple, and yellow flowers. Sunlight casts strong shadows across the scene, with hanging flower baskets on the walls and green shutters on the windows.
